iWant: Squire to know my Claude plan and how much I have used, pace itself, never spend beyond my plan without my yes, and tell me once if an upgrade would really help
soThat: I stay within what I pay for and the choice to pay more is always mine
description: The Squire owner declares the plan tier; Squire reads usage from Claude Code. Defaults: pacing above 80% of the five-hour window and above 70% of the weekly window; stale or missing usage counts as unknown.
title: Plan awareness: knows the plan, paces itself, never spends beyond it

acceptanceCriteria.description: Squire knows the Squire owner's Claude plan and usage, and paces itself.
acceptanceCriteria.given: The plan the Squire owner declared, and a usage reading above the pacing threshold
acceptanceCriteria.when: A job that can wait comes up
acceptanceCriteria.then: Squire has recorded the declared plan, defers the job and tells the Squire owner when the allowance resets; when usage is stale or missing, Squire treats it as unknown.

acceptanceCriteria.description: Squire never spends beyond the Squire owner's plan without their yes.
acceptanceCriteria.given: No yes from the Squire owner to spend beyond the plan
acceptanceCriteria.when: Squire, or a tool it calls, tries to turn on usage credits or to pick a model that needs usage credits

acceptanceCriteria.description: When an upgrade would really help, Squire says so once and leaves the choice to the Squire owner.
acceptanceCriteria.given: Mostly requested work, and either three five-hour limits reached in a week or one weekly limit reached in a month
acceptanceCriteria.when: The trigger is met, and the Squire owner later says no to the advice
acceptanceCriteria.then: Squire gives the advice once, never before the trigger, and changes nothing about the plan itself; after a no it does not give it again for a month.
